### Senior Review Summary (`approved`)

- **Correctness**: All 22 units in `change_plan.md` are implemented accurately (`ArrowheadSize` type and constants, `getArrowheadSize`/`getArrowheadAngle`/`getCardinalityMarkerScale`/`getArrowheadSizeBeyondLastSegment`/`getArrowheadPoints` scaling, `elbowArrow.ts` and `transform.ts` clearance readers, `newLinearElement`/`newArrowElement` default omission, `restoreElement`/`restoreAppState` sanitization, `actionChangeArrowheadSize`, `actionPasteStyles`, and `currentItemArrowheadSize` state).
- **Type safety**: Narrowed `ArrowheadSize` validation (`isValidArrowheadSize` type guard) and strict typing across `@excalidraw/element` and `@excalidraw/excalidraw` (`yarn test:typecheck` passed).
- **Error handling & invariants**: Out-of-range, non-finite, and default (`1`) values are sanitized on element construction and scene/appState restoration; `invariant` guards `actionChangeArrowheadSize`.
- **DRY**: Shared constants (`ARROWHEAD_SIZES`, `DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE`, `MIN_ARROWHEAD_SIZE`, `MAX_ARROWHEAD_SIZE`) and `isValidArrowheadSize` exported from `@excalidraw/element` and reused across packages.
- **Test coverage**: Comprehensive unit and integration tests in `bounds.test.ts`, `restore.test.ts`, and `arrowheadSize.test.tsx` covering geometry scaling, angle invariance, short-segment fitting, restoration, SVG export, UI controls, undo/redo, copy/paste styles, and reconciliation.
